CustomField.description: # of the days the opportunity was open. Includes the day the Opportunity was opened.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK( Date_100__c ), NOW() - CreatedDate, Date_100__c - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) )+1
CustomField.inlineHelpText: # of the days the opportunity was open. Includes the day the Opportunity was opened.
CustomField.label: Days Open
